intervention_definition.advance_rule: at the first decision opportunity after discovery where the candidate is legal and payable in the real sequential budget walk, the original greedy HOLD of a named target is overridden to SEND
intervention_definition.already_sending: if the original action is already SEND there is no second send; the no-action-difference is recorded
intervention_definition.not_deployable: the target IDs come from a failing case; this is a privileged diagnostic intervention, not a general deployable rule
intervention_definition.one_per_target: at most one override per target; a lost packet adds no retransmission
intervention_definition.real_path_only: the override lives inside the real sequential budget decision path, uses the actual balance and quote, keeps the candidate order, never appends an emission after the collector decided, never sends free, reserves extra budget or bypasses the mask
intervention_definition.restore_after_first_emission: after the first emission the original learned logic is fully restored; other targets are never overridden; later actions are recomputed in the real closed-loop state

launch_budget.counting_rule: every failure, retry and smoke run counts; no throughput probe or confirmation run beyond the five paths

controller_parameter_summary.note: actor+task critic mirror the pilot round's Controller; the cost head is the constrained objective's addition (Stage A: new trainer state)

identity.decode: SEND iff p(SEND) >= p(HOLD), ties to SEND (original frozen greedy decode)

parameters.note: actor+task critic mirror the pilot round's Controller; the cost head is the constrained objective's addition (Stage A: new trainer state)

L.role: original learned path, no interceptor installed

rng_registration.action_rng: torch.manual_seed(eval_action_seed(33, 1400031, 'greedy')) per path, identical label and formula to ROUND25
rng_registration.environment_and_channel_rng: derived inside the driver from the scenario seed; the override draws nothing, but an extra emission consumes channel loss draws, so post-intervention paths legitimately diverge
rng_registration.forbidden_claims: not the same per-message loss batch; outcome changes are not attributable to one accepted message

scenario_seminar: post-hoc selected failing scene from the ROUND26 diagnosis; a privileged diagnostic scenario, not a random sample

start_ledger_plan.reserve: 3 launches reserved for technical failures and retries of a failed cell only; reserve consumption is booked like any launch

stopping_rules: stop after the five paths complete, or on a technical-health/quota stop
an unexplained behavioural drift between L and L0 stops the round before E0/E5/E05
a behavioural-semantics defect stops the round; no mixed implementations in one panel
no continued training, candidate swap, confirmation or deployment
